B1_vanilla.label: B1 vanilla (LLM self-abstention only)
B1_vanilla.notes: Answers everything the LLM answers; confidence = normalised top-1 cosine.

B2_grounding_only.label: B2 grounding only (no thresholds)
B2_grounding_only.notes: Full confidence score reported, no abstention thresholds.

TriSafe_lexical.label: TriSafe-RAG with lexical (Jaccard) grounding
TriSafe_lexical.notes: Same policy, Jaccard grounding instead of NLI.

TriSafe_rrf.label: TriSafe-RAG with raw RRF retrieval signal
TriSafe_rrf.notes: Legacy retrieval signal; shows the effect of the near-constant RRF scale.

TriSafe_perlang.label: TriSafe-RAG + per-language thresholds (dev)
TriSafe_perlang.notes: Fairness enforced by language-specific answer thresholds.

E3_platt.label: E3 Platt (logistic) on the five signals

E4_isotonic.label: E4 isotonic on the TriSafe sum

E5_temperature.label: E5 temperature scaling on the TriSafe sum

E6_translate_retrieve.label: E6 translate-then-retrieve + TriSafe policy
E6_translate_retrieve.notes: Non-English queries translated to English by the same LLM before retrieval.
